HubSpot Snap Pack
HubSpot Snap Pack allows you to integrate customer and lead data in the HubSpot platform with other key systems of record. 
Book a Demo
Key Features of the Hubspot Snap Pack
HubSpot Snap Pack allows you to integrate customer and leads data in the HubSpot platform with other key systems of record.
HubSpot is powerful marketing, sales, and service software that helps you grow your business. It is especially well known as a great marketing automation platform. With this Snap Pack, you can easily perform CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) operations on various entities in the HubSpot platform such as customers, leads, marketing assets, etc. 
With this Snap Pack, you can automate workflows such as
Loading leads data from demand generation tools such as digital ads, digital events as well as field events
Loading event and survey data and sync that with the customer data
Managing customer service issues and keeping your customer-facing teams updated 
Pushing the customer data to analytics endpoints to identify upsell opportunities for higher revenue and training opportunities for better customer success etc.
And many more …  
HubSpot Snap Pack has the following Snaps:
Create: Creates an entity in the HubSpot platform
Read: Retrieves the specified entity’s details from HubSpot.
Delete: Deletes the specified entity from HubSpot.
Update: Updates an entity in HubSpot.
To learn more, please check out the HubSpot Snap Pack documentation.
